sections.section: 1. Create one workspace for one client
sections.note: Client 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Accept-7' was created through Clients > New. Enable co-managed IT was filled in on the client's Co-managed IT tab: workspace 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Accept-7 IT', 1 seat, Oversight of the initial service desk board, General Support queue. The UI briefly showed 'Queued', then 'Awaiting customer acceptance' after reload. Exactly one operation and one allocation exist for this customer; the allocation was reserved and the relationship not active until acceptance. The intermediate 'Preparing workspace' label was not caught in the UI.

The invitation was opened from the SMTP sink. The administrator set a password on /auth/team/setup and was signed into the new customer tenant. The review screen showed the sponsor (Oz), 'Service Desk — View and collaborate', the General Support escalation queue, and 'no shared projects or delegated workspace administration'. A deep link to /msp/tickets still showed the review screen before acceptance. After 'Accept and activate workspace' and the first-run setup, the Ticketing Dashboard survived a reload. The relationship became active with 1 board scope, 0 project scopes and 0 delegated grants. The MSP client view showed Active, offered no Cancel setup, and the allocation became active.

Resend administrator invitation on the pending setup delivered a second mail to the sink with the same operation, tenant and single allocation. For the second setup the provision response was dropped in the browser after the server executed it. The form showed 'The request result could not be confirmed. Retry these same details to recover it.' and kept the details. Resubmitting recovered the same operation (one operation, one allocation). Doc/UI mismatch: the guide says to use 'Retry', but after a lost response the button still reads 'Create workspace and invite administrator'. Worker-failure recovery, expired invitation and invitation delivery failure were not induced.

On 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-01 Cancel-7' (Escalated tickets only, never accepted): Cancel setup opened 'Cancel workspace setup?', then Delete workspace and cancel. DB states observed: cleanup_requested with the seat still reserved, then cancelled with the seat released. The customer tenant row is gone and the allocation was released once. The accepted Accept-7 workspace stayed Active. Refusal for a claimed workspace was checked only as the absence of Cancel setup on the accepted client.

sections.note: Simulator evidence. Alice's session is the White Rabbit workspace, and outbound email is Nine Minds Managed (not replaced). Email > Inbound > Open Providers reaches the customer workbench. Alice created the Microsoft app registration 'CM-REVIEW-20261026-12-c simulator app' with the operator-prepared Graph simulator client (cm-review-rabbit-client, White Rabbit Review Directory). It persisted in microsoft_profiles under White Rabbit only. After reload the secret appears masked ('••••…' plus its last 4 characters); the full secret is not in page HTML or text. The back link returns to Email settings, also after reload. /msp/settings/integrations is 'Page not available' for the customer. QA (Oz), signed in separately, sees the sponsor catalog without the customer binding, and Oz has no such profile.

Not executable. The MSP sign-in page offers only email/password, with no SSO entry. Production-mode SSO safeguards were left unchanged. In the customer's Security > Single Sign-On, Microsoft 365 shows 'Not configured' and bulk Microsoft assignment is disabled. No approved Microsoft Entra application with a publicly reachable redirect URI exists, so no provider redirect or callback was attempted.

sections.note: Outbound delivery works but the audience is wrong. Alice created requester contact cm-review-20261026-12-c.requester@whiterabbit.test and a ticket for it, then posted three comments: Shared IT teams, Private to White Rabbit IT, and Requester and IT teams. The requester-audience update reached the controlled SMTP-sink mailbox exactly once. However, the 'Shared IT teams' body was also emailed to the requester (defect below). The private body was excluded. Reply ingestion is blocked: there is no inbound mailbox binding (Inbound shows Gmail 0, Microsoft 0, IMAP 0) and the sink is outbound only.
